candidate.claim: defu is cast to DefuInstance which requires fn, arrayFn and extend, but the implementation never assigns them; defu.fn/defu.arrayFn/defu.extend are undefined at runtime so typed calls throw.
candidate.title: defu instance missing fn/arrayFn/extend implementations

verifier.reason: Confirmed: types.ts:49-57 requires fn, arrayFn and extend on DefuInstance, but defu.ts:45-52 shows createDefu returns a bare arrow function and defu is only cast with `as DefuInstance` with no property assignments anywhere in defu.ts.
